_about: What the runtime's CLI layer (runtime/paseo-cli.mjs runPaseo) got back, byte for byte, from `paseo run` (CLI 1.4.1) refused before it made an agent: ask-missing is the structured-output form (executor.ask) and spawn-missing the --background form (executor.spawn, with the CLI's deprecation line) given a workspace id that does not exist; ask-archived the same for a workspace that was archived; unknown-option an option the CLI does not know (--bogus-flag standing in for --workspace on an older CLI). Measured 2026-10-27. Edited: the workspace ids (random, one per workspace) are replaced by the placeholder wks_0000000000000000; nothing else is (no paths, names or other ids were in them).
